translations.10: You have lunch with your teammates.
translations.12: On day two, you spend the whole day on site.
translations.13: Wear safety shoes when you observe unloading work.
translations.14: Do not start conversations with drivers while they are working.
translations.15: Send your experience report to your team lead for approval.
translations.16: Once the team lead has checked it, it goes to Manager Byun.
translations.18: In their first week, new MoaLogis hires work through a task list called "Launchpad."
translations.19: Launchpad 1 is logging in to the wiki and joining the company messenger.
translations.20: Company announcements and chatter happen in the "Hearth" channel.
translations.21: Leave a short self-introduction in Hearth.
translations.22: Launchpad 2 is taking the training for Pathfinder, the fleet allocation system.
translations.23: Plan a full day of fleet allocation in Pathfinder yourself.
translations.24: Do not post your practice screens in Hearth.
translations.25: Your report does not need to be long.
translations.26: Once you finish every Launchpad task, you start real work in week two.
translations.27: Your first real task is a code review together with Seojin Um.
translations.28: Share the code review results in your team's channel in Hearth.
translations.29: If you have questions, ask Manager Byun at any time.
translations.3: This page walks you through what to do in your first two weeks, in order.
translations.30: Finally, leave a one-line note in Hearth and you're done.
translations.4: For questions, ask Joonho Byun, the HR manager.
translations.5: Seojin Um will help you set up your development environment.
translations.7: When you arrive, first pick up your badge at the front desk on the first floor.
translations.8: Manager Byun will register the badge for you.
translations.9: Your desk is next to the Dawn Team, and Seojin Um sits in the same row.
